sidebar.title: Your navigation
sidebar.description: Everything you need is in this sidebar. Quick access to all intranet sections.

header.title: Quick actions
header.description: Notifications, settings, and your account are always available up here.

actions.title: Quick actions
actions.description: Jump straight into the things you do most — request an absence, upload a file, or (as a manager) create events and announcements. On desktop, ⌘K opens the search palette from anywhere.

main.title: Your dashboard
main.description: A snapshot of what's happening — upcoming events, latest news, who's out today, and pending items. Every row links to the tab it came from.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.description: Hide the cards you don't need — your layout is saved to your account and follows you across devices.

nav.title: Company announcements
nav.description: Stay up to date with news and updates from across the organisation.

toolbar.title: Find what matters
toolbar.description: Search the feed, filter to unread or pinned posts, sort by reactions, or clear everything with mark-all-read. Posts count as read once you've actually scrolled past them.

list.title: The announcements feed
list.description: Pinned posts stay on top; long posts collapse behind "read more". React with emoji, open images full-size, and download attachments.

new.title: Publish announcements
new.description: Write rich-text posts for everyone or one department — you'll see how many people it will reach. Pin important ones, schedule for later, set an expiry, and edit after publishing. A draft is kept if you close the dialog.

nav.title: Team calendar
nav.description: View and create events visible to everyone or specific teams.

toolbar.title: Navigate the calendar
toolbar.description: Switch between month, week and agenda views, page through periods with the arrows (or your keyboard's ← → keys, T for today), jump straight to a date, and export the current view as an .ics file.

filters.title: Focus the view
filters.description: The legend is interactive: click a type to hide or show it, narrow to one department, or keep only your own absences. Department-targeted events get their own color.

view.title: Events and absences together
view.description: Events and approved absences (including those synced from Clockodo) share one calendar. Multi-day entries span every day they cover; click a day for its overview or any chip for details.

add.title: Create events
add.description: As a manager you can create events for everyone or a single department. From an event's details you can edit or duplicate it, and clicking a day offers a quick-create shortcut.

nav.title: Absences
nav.description: Request and track vacation, sick days, and personal time.

request.title: Request time off
request.description: Create a new absence request — pick the type, the dates, and an optional note for your approver. You'll see the working-day count and a warning if the range overlaps an existing absence.

stats.title: Your year at a glance
stats.description: Vacation days used, sick days, and open requests for the current year, calculated from your approved absences.

filters.title: Filter your history
filters.description: Narrow the list by status or type. Below, everything is grouped by year — click any entry for its full timeline.

list.title: Your absence requests
list.description: Track approval status here. Pending requests can still be edited or cancelled; absences synced from Clockodo are read-only and marked with a badge.

approvals.title: Team approvals
approvals.description: Requests from your reports land in this tab. Approve or deny them (optionally with a note), and see who on the team is out over the next two weeks.

nav.title: Team messaging
nav.description: Direct messages and group conversations with your colleagues.

list.title: Your conversations
list.description: Start a new chat or pick up where you left off.

nav.title: People directory
nav.description: Find colleagues, see their role, department, and start a chat.

filters.title: Find anyone fast
filters.description: Search matches names, emails, job titles and teams. Combine the department select with role and team chips, change the sorting, group by department, or jump by letter.

grid.title: Browse your team
grid.description: A green dot means someone is online right now; a plane marks colleagues who are currently out. Click a card for the full profile — contact links, manager and direct reports, and upcoming absences.

nav.title: Guidebooks
nav.description: SOPs, case search, and team knowledge — all in one place.

list.title: Your knowledge base
list.description: Open any guide to follow step-by-step procedures or search across topics.

bell.title: Notification bell
bell.description: The bell turns active when something needs your attention.

feed.title: All notifications
feed.description: Absence approvals, new announcements, and system alerts collected here.

nav.title: Your settings
nav.description: Personalise your profile, change your language, and pick a theme.

profile.title: Profile card
profile.description: Keep your name, job title, and contact details up to date so colleagues can find you.

nav.title: Admin panel
nav.description: Manage your team: invite members, approve access requests, and adjust roles.

members.title: Member management
members.description: The Members tab lets you change roles, manage teams, suspend, or remove users.

nav.title: Activity tracking
nav.description: Monitor device activity, employee states, and generate reports for your fleet.

stats.title: Fleet overview
stats.description: Live counts show who's active, idle, or offline across all tracked devices.

nav.title: Files
nav.description: Browse the team's OneDrive right here in the intranet.

toolbar.title: Search, upload & more
toolbar.description: Find files, switch folders, and check storage at a glance.

dropzone.title: Drag & drop to upload
dropzone.description: Drop files from your desktop, or use this button. Employee uploads go to a manager for approval first.

browser.title: Open and preview
browser.description: Click a folder to open it, or a file to preview and download.

Admin.subtitle: Manage access, members, invites and guest logins.

Admin.inviteExternalForbidden: Only admins can invite external email addresses.
Admin.inviteExternalBody: {email} is outside your company domains. They'll receive a Clerk invitation and get full access as the selected role. Send it anyway?

Guidebooks.title: Guidebooks
Guidebooks.subtitle: Reference guides and tools for your team

Guidebooks.notFoundHint: It may have been moved or removed.
Guidebooks.noAccessHint: It's restricted to other teams. Ask an admin if you need access.

caseSearch.title: Case Management — Keyword Search
caseSearch.description: Type a keyword to instantly find the matching case fields and queue.

problembehandlungen.title: Troubleshooting — IT & Workstation
problembehandlungen.description: First aid for audio, browser, display and internet problems — step by step with screenshots.

onedriveSchulung.title: OneDrive — Training
onedriveSchulung.description: Open OneDrive, use bookmarks properly and upload files.
